vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: seo-content-pro
Version: 1.1.0

The skill bundle is a legitimate SEO content generation tool. The included Python script, `scripts/title_generator.py`, performs simple string manipulation to generate and score article titles based on templates without any network or file system access. The `SKILL.md` file provides functional instructions for the AI agent to perform SEO tasks and research via a user-configured SearXNG instance, and it contains no evidence of malicious prompt injections, data exfiltration, or unauthorized execution logic.

llm.summary: The skill's requests and included files are consistent with an SEO content tool: no unrelated credentials, no installers, and only a small title-generation script; nothing indicates covert behavior.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (SEO research, outline, draft, scoring) align with declared requirements: python3 and curl are reasonable for fetching pages and running small scripts. The included title_generator.py is a benign utility that fits the stated features.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructions focus on researching via a SearXNG instance, generating outlines/drafts, and scoring content. It does not instruct reading unrelated system files, harvesting credentials, or exfiltrating data beyond the stated research endpoint.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install specification (instruction-only), so nothing is downloaded or written to disk by an installer. One small Python script is included in the bundle; no external install URLs or archives are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required credentials are requested (proportional). The SKILL.md exposes optional env vars (CONTENT_TONE, DEFAULT_LENGTH, CONTENT_LANGUAGE, SEARXNG_URL). Important: SEARXNG_URL can point to any SearXNG instance — if you set it to a remote/untrusted server, search queries and topics (and potentially pasted article text during 'content refresh') could be sent to that server.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill does not request always:true, does not modify other skills or system-wide settings, and is user-invocable. Autonomous invocation is allowed by platform default but is not combined here with broad privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it needs python3 and curl, includes a harmless title-generation script, and relies on a SearXNG instance for research. Before installing: (1) be cautious where SEARXNG_URL points — prefer a local or trusted instance to avoid leaking search queries or pasted article content; (2) avoid pasting sensitive/private articles into the skill when using a remote research endpoint; (3) review the included scripts (title_generator.py is small and benign) and monitor network activity on first use; (4) note the author/homepage are missing, so trust is based on the package contents rather than an established publisher. If you need stronger assurance, ask the publisher for a homepage or audit logs, or run the skill in an isolated environment first.
